statement: In iid uniformly elliptic nearest-neighbor RWRE on Z^d, d>=3, two walks independent conditional on one shared environment need not have independent annealed first jumps.
assumptions: Independent site variables W_x take 1/4 and 3/4 equiprobably.
omega(x,+e1)=W_x; each other edge has probability (1-W_x)/(2d-1).
Both walks start at 0 and are conditionally independent given omega.
proof_or_counterexample: P(X1=e1)=P(Y1=e1)=1/2; joint=E W_0^2=5/16; marginal product=1/4; conditional P(Y1=e1|X1=e1)=5/8. Uniform ellipticity lower bound is 1/[4(2d-1)].

statement: For fixed nonzero l, the union zero-one law plus exclusion of simultaneous positive P0(A_l) and P0(A_-l) implies signed zero-one; under the union law signed zero-one for both signs is equivalent to that exclusion.
proof_or_counterexample: The signs are disjoint. Their probabilities sum to the union probability. If the union is zero both vanish; if it is one, exclusion of positive coexistence forces one sign to have probability one. Conversely, signed zero-one and disjointness exclude positive coexistence.
remaining_gap: Exclude positive coexistence in the full iid d>=3 class.
